description.zh: 适配文件ID。此功能灰度开放，如未约定使用请勿传入。
description.en: 适配文件ID。此功能灰度开放，如未约定使用请勿传入。

description.zh:
应用版本ID。

> 当您未指定生效版本时，默认应用最新版本。
description.en:
Application Version ID.

> If you do not specify an active version, the default application uses the latest version.

description.zh: 业务的客户端IP，比如云游戏场景中玩家的IP。
description.en: Client IP address of the business, such as the player's IP address in a cloud gaming scenario.

description.zh:
自定义会话ID，保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

> 支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en:
Custom session ID used to ensure idempotence of requests.  

Generate a unique value from your client to guarantee uniqueness across different requests.  

> ASCII characters are supported, and the length must not exceed 64 characters.

description.zh:
自定义用户ID，最大长度不超过64个字符。

用于业务对用户维度做相应的操作。 

> 当应用类型为`end_game`、`hand_game`时，本参数必填。
description.en:
Custom User ID, with a maximum length of 64 characters.  

Used by your business to perform operations based on the user dimension.  

> This parameter is Required when the application Type is `end_game` or `hand_game`.

description.zh:

- huabei

- huazhong
description.en:
Area ID. Valid values:  

- huadong  

- xinan  

- huanan

description.zh:
按量付费模式下创建会话时，是否按需生产资源。取值范围：
- true：是
- false：否，默认false
description.en:
Specifies whether to provision resources on demand when creating a session in pay-as-you-go mode. Valid values:  
- true: Yes  
- false: No (default)

description.zh: 项目ID。如果已将应用关联到项目，创建会话时需填写正确的项目ID。
description.en: 项目ID。如果已将应用关联到项目，创建会话时需填写正确的项目ID。

description.zh: 系统信息，如客户端侧机型等信息。
description.en: System information, such as client device model.

description.zh:
按量付费模式按需生产资源的超时时间。
取值范围 [900, 43200]秒，默认值1800。
description.en:
Timeout for on-demand resource provisioning in pay-as-you-go mode.  
Value range: [900, 43200] seconds. Default value: 1800.

取值：
true：启动成功。
false：启动失败。| |eventType|String|是|事件类型。| |customSessionId|String|是|自定义会话ID。| |platformSessionId|String|是|平台会话ID。| |customTaskId|String|否|自定义任务ID。| |platformTaskId|String|否|平台任务ID。| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|是|事件详情。| |errorMessage|Object[EventDetail]|否|错误详情。

descriptions.en:
- After a session is created successfully, the event type is `APP_START`. The result of application startup is notified through the following message. >Applies only to API integration mode and not to H5 SDK integration mode.> |Name | Type | Required |Description| | ------ | ------ | ------ |------ | | success | Boolean | Yes |Indicates whether the startup succeeded.
Valid values:
true: Startup succeeded.
false: Startup failed.| |eventType|String|Yes|Event type.| |customSessionId|String|Yes|Custom session ID.| |platformSessionId|String|Yes|Platform session ID.| |customTaskId|String|No|Custom task ID.| |platformTaskId|String|No|Platform task ID.| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|Yes|Event details.| |errorMessage|Object[EventDetail]|No|Error Details.
This parameter is returned when startup fails.| |tags|Map|No|Session labels.| The EventDetail data structure is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| | ------ | ------ | ------ |------ | |appId|String|Yes|Application ID.| |appVersion|String|Yes|Application Version ID.| |appBizConfig|String|No|Custom business configuration data used during platform adaptation.| |streamingToken|String|No|Streaming authentication information. This field is included only when a streaming service exists.| |endpoint|Object[Endpoint]|No|Event details.
This parameter is returned when startup succeeds.| The Endpoint data structure is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| |-------|-------|-------|-------| |name|String|Yes|Name.| |type|String|Yes|Type.| |accessHost|String|Yes|Endpoint IP address.| |accessPort|String|Yes|Endpoint port.| |isp|String|Yes|Carrier identity.
Valid values:
MOBILE: China Mobile.
UNICOM: China Unicom.
TELECOM: China Telecom.
BGP: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP).| |districtId|String|Yes|Area ID.| |regionId|String|Yes|Region ID.| The ErrorMessage data structure is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| |------|------|------|------| |code|String|Yes|Error code.| |msg|String|Yes|Error Details.| - For services involving streaming, after a session is created successfully, the event type is `APP_STREAMING_INIT`. Streaming initialization information is notified through the following message. >Applies only to API integration mode and not to H5 SDK integration mode.> | Name | Type | Required |Description| | ------ | ------ | ------ |------ | | success | Boolean | Yes |Indicates whether streaming initialization succeeded.
Valid values:
true: Initialization succeeded.
false: Initialization failed.| |eventType|String|Yes|Event type.| |customSessionId|String|Yes|Custom session ID.| |platformSessionId|String|Yes|Platform session ID.| |customTaskId|String|No|Custom task ID.| |platformTaskId|String|No|Platform task ID.| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|Yes|Event details.| The EventDetail data structure is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| | ------ | ------ | ------ |------ | |appId|String|Yes|Application ID.| |appVersion|String|Yes|Application Version ID.| |appBizConfig|String|No|Custom business configuration data used during platform adaptation.| |streamingToken|String|No|Streaming authentication information. This field is included only when a streaming service exists.| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|No|Event details.
This parameter is returned when session startup succeeds.| |errorMessage|Object|No|Error Details.
This parameter is returned when session startup fails.| The Endpoint data structure is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| |-------|-------|-------|-------| |name|String|Yes|Name.| |type|String|Yes|Type.| |accessHost|String|Yes|Endpoint IP address.| |accessPort|String|Yes|Endpoint port.| |isp|String|Yes|
Carrier identity.
Valid values:
MOBILE: China Mobile.
UNICOM: China Unicom.
TELECOM: China Telecom.
BGP: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP).| |districtId|String|Yes|Area ID.| |regionId|String|Yes|Region ID.| The ErrorMessage data structure is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| |------|------|------|------| |code|String|Yes|Error code.| |msg|String|Yes|Error Details.|
